adaptations: Source ids are UUIDs. This project uses integer primary keys, so source ids are kept here for traceability and are not inserted as restaurants.id or reviews.id.

Restaurants are upserted on google_place_id. Five listings had no resolved Place ID; they use pending:<source_id> so the NOT NULL unique column can store them. Do not send those placeholders to the Places API.

reviews.rating and reviews.published_at are NOT NULL. Missing star ratings are filled with that restaurant's google_rating (rating_imputed=true). Missing publish times use the dataset snapshot (published_at_imputed=true).
Review source UUIDs are stored in external_review_id so the load can be re-run without duplicating rows.
Listing ratings and user_rating_count come from the SQL snapshot, which fills values the JSON export left null and is the newer Google-linked count.

reviews.text: The chicken salad and shredded chicken rice were the highlights, with tender chicken and generous portions. The lemongrass-braised chicken, however, was disappointing: the serving contained considerably more skin and bone than meat... Service could benefit from better training and greater attentiveness.
Cơm gà Phú Yên is famous for its crispy scorched rice, flavorful chicken dishes, and delicious young chicken eggs. The chicken is tender and richly seasoned.
Food is just meh, too oily and the chicken meat is not at all fresh. The rice looks sad, too dry and even not fully cooked... Staff looks burnt out and not friendly. I probably will never come back.

The menu here mainly features chicken dishes... the other dishes are decent, especially considering the price point... the staff is always enthusiastic about seating guests... most branches lack air conditioning.

The food itself was flavorful — especially the chicken — but the portions felt a little small for the price... service was slower than expected... the space is comfortable enough, but it could use a bit more attention to cleanliness during peak hours.
The main dishes are always the same but well-prepared... the secret lies in the side dishes or appetizers... they are divine and constantly changing and original...
We had a yummy dinner after yoga. The small side dishes "banchan" are plentiful... Real taste of Korean basic meal which price is very reasonable...
Here is famous place for basic korean foods. All dish is delicious, and the staff is kind. Only one problem is.. sometimes, attitude of owner is not that good.
Personally the octopus was a bit plan for me but the fish and soup were pretty good. Will go back to taste crab. The menu is a little bit limited though.
The side dishes were sweet. The fish was thin, small, and lacked meat. I wish they would pay more attention to the taste.
The meals so fantastic, the ambiance wonderful, the drinks so pretty and refreshing... we can see edible flowers is in the ice ball...
Generally a nice and cute place. Nice ambience... Menu is quite interesting and portions are pretty decent too.
The food is delicious, though a bit pricey. The presentation is beautiful, and I especially liked the truffle mushroom fries. The drinks are good as well.
The decoration is very modern and fun. I enjoy the atmosphere here a lot... The portion of food is hugeeee and quite tasty... The server - Bin is very considerate...
The ambience at this place was PERFECTION — the perfect lighting, music volume and decor... The food was AMAZING and the staff were all incredibly friendly...

Chi nhánh Thảo Điền - Thịt tươi ngon Vị kim chi không chua Vị món ăn kèm với mình hơi ngọt - Nhân viên nhiệt tình rất dễ thương... Các bạn nhân viên nướng luôn cho khách. Bàn ngoài trời khiến mình rất hài lòng. To, ngồi thoải mái, không khói. -Có chỗ để xe thoải mái.

Đồ ăn - Ngọt. Không đặc sắc - thịt bò mềm. Ổn - món ăn kèm không ngon... chỗ ngồi thoải mái - có chỗ để xe - vỉ nướng tốt. Nhân viên rất tốt... ít thức ăn so với giá tiền... Đồ ăn không đặc sắc để quay lại.
